_doc: 품절 임박 편 원화 (2026-11-23). 구조는 판테온 v5 art_sheets_v5.json 과 같음(common + sheets + tail). 참조는 channel.yaml character.refs 두 장만: 지우 기준판 refs/ch-knowledge/jiwoo_board.png + 잼 편 tasting.png. 지우 옷 = 기준판 오른쪽 아래 전신 칸의 연분홍·흰 체크 잠옷(모든 시트 같게). 그림 속 글자·숫자 없음 — 가격·'3개 남음'·시계·숫자는 렌더러 오버레이. 휴대폰 화면은 빈 빛나는 사각형. Codex $imagegen (-m gpt-6-sol), 원본 Drive 영상/20261123-curiosity-soldout/art/<시트>.png, 프롬프트 전문 <시트>.txt
common:
Create ONE wide 16:9 landscape image that is a perfect full-bleed 2x2 sheet of four separate 16:9 film frames (four equal rectangles, no gutters, no margins, no borders). Each frame is a new frame of the SAME animated film as the two attached images.

THE CHARACTER (most important): Ji-woo is the woman on the first attached image, 'jiwoo_board' - a board of panels cut directly from the finished films (eight face panels on top, four full-body panels below). Wherever Ji-woo appears, draw the SAME person in the SAME drawing method as on that board: the same face and face proportions, the same eyes, nose and mouth, the same hair (dark, softly wavy, chin-length bob with a side part and a small brown hair clip on her right side), the same adult body proportions as in the full-body panels, the same outline weight, the same colouring, the same light and the same surface texture. Do NOT make her younger, cuter or simpler than the board, and do NOT make her more realistic or more detailed than the board.

THE DRAWING METHOD (equally important): every frame - including frames without Ji-woo, the other people, the rooms, the objects and the backgrounds - is drawn as if the same artist drew more frames for the same film as the two attached images: the same dark outline weight and line quality, the same soft cel colouring with the same few light and shadow steps, the same warm gentle light, and backgrounds painted with the same level of detail as in the second attached image 'tasting'. Glass, metal, screens and paper are painted the way wood, shelves and cloth are painted in the attached images: soft hand-painted animation background art. No photographic or semi-realistic rendering, no photographic textures, no oil-painting look, no 3D look.

CLOTHES (her face, hair and the drawing method never change): Ji-woo wears the SAME light pink-and-white checked pyjamas as in the bottom-right full-body panel of the board, in every frame. Her room is always the same small Korean one-room apartment bedroom at night: a single bed against the wall with a cream duvet, a wooden bedside table with a small round lamp turned low, a window with sheer curtains and distant city lights, a clothes rack by the wall. At night her face is lit by the cool pale glow of her phone plus the warm low lamp.

THE PHONE: whenever her smartphone screen is visible, the screen is an EMPTY, evenly glowing pale rectangle - no interface, no pictures, no text, no numbers, no icons.
tail: Keep the main subject of each frame above the bottom fifth of the frame (subtitle area). Absolutely no text, letters, digits, numbers, clocks with numerals, logos, price tags with writing, labels or watermarks anywhere (papers, screens, signs and book covers are left blank).

sheets.room1: Top left: wide view of Ji-woo's dark bedroom late at night, Ji-woo curled up under the cream duvet in bed, only her head and hands out, her face lit by the glow of the phone she holds close, the low warm lamp on the bedside table, city lights in the window. Top right: medium close-up of Ji-woo lying on her side on the pillow, her face lit cool by the phone, lips pressed together, hesitating. Bottom left: over-the-shoulder view from behind Ji-woo in bed, her two hands holding the phone upright, the phone's empty glowing screen large in the right half of the frame. Bottom right: extreme close-up of her right thumb hovering just above the lower part of the phone's empty glowing screen, tense, about to tap, the duvet soft and dark behind.
sheets.room2: Top left: an earlier evening, Ji-woo sitting on the edge of her bed in the same pyjamas, lowering her phone with a small relaxed shrug, as if deciding 'maybe later', calm lamp light. Top right: tonight, Ji-woo suddenly propped up on her elbows in bed, eyes wide, leaning in toward the phone, a little startled and eager. Bottom left: a simple product illustration - a dark-navy hooded winter puffer jacket shown alone from the front, centered on a plain soft light-grey background, like a picture in a shopping catalogue, no labels, no people. Bottom right: Ji-woo sitting up in bed hugging her knees under the duvet, holding the phone in both hands, her thumb raised in mid-air and frozen, her eyes fixed on the screen.
sheets.cookie1: All four frames take place in 1975, in a plain small psychology laboratory room at an American university: beige walls, a wooden table, a wooden chair, one door. Top left: a clear glass jar with a metal screw lid holding ten chocolate chip cookies, standing on the wooden table, warm light, no people. Top right: the same glass jar on the same table with only two chocolate chip cookies at the bottom, no people. Bottom left: a college student (a young man with shoulder-length brown hair and a mustard-yellow turtleneck, 1970s style) seated at the table with a cookie jar in front of him, and a researcher (a man in his thirties with glasses, short-sleeved white shirt and narrow tie) standing beside him holding a clipboard. Bottom right: the same student taking a bite of a chocolate chip cookie with a thoughtful look, a blank questionnaire sheet and a pencil on the table.
sheets.cookie2: Same 1975 laboratory room, the same student (shoulder-length brown hair, mustard-yellow turtleneck) and the same researchers. Top left: the student looking at a glass jar that holds only two chocolate chip cookies, eyebrows raised, clearly wanting them. Top right: two different students at two separate small tables side by side, one with a full cookie jar and one with a jar of only two cookies, both chewing a cookie with the very same calm neutral expression. Bottom left: the lab door opening and a second researcher (a young woman with long straight 1970s hair and a beige cardigan) stepping in, holding a glass jar with only two cookies. Bottom right: close-up on the table: the young woman researcher's hands lifting away the full ten-cookie jar while setting down the two-cookie jar in front of the seated student.
sheets.cookie3: Same 1975 laboratory room and the same people. Top left: close-up under the edge of the wooden table: the male researcher's finger secretly pressing a small hidden button mounted under the table, his clipboard above, the student unaware. Top right: the student staring at the two-cookie jar that is now in front of him, surprised and then longing. Bottom left: the young woman researcher with an apologetic smile, one hand on the back of her neck, holding the full jar she just took. Bottom right: through the open lab door, a glimpse of a second room where several other students are happily eating cookies from jars, the young woman researcher gesturing back toward that room with her thumb.
sheets.cookie4: Same 1975 laboratory. Top left: the student (mustard-yellow turtleneck) looking at his two cookies, with a soft thought bubble above his head showing many people happily eating cookies; desire in his eyes. Top right: a researcher's desk with tall stacks of journals, folders and papers piled high, a desk lamp, everything blank with no writing, suggesting many studies collected together. Bottom left: a different student (a young woman with curly dark hair and a green sweater) in the same lab chair, arms crossed, narrowing her eyes and glancing sideways at the researcher with a knowing look, as if she has figured out the trick. Bottom right: the same curly-haired student calmly sliding the two-cookie jar away from herself with one finger, unimpressed.
sheets.room3: Back in Ji-woo's dark bedroom at night. Top left: Ji-woo in bed, her thumb lowered, frowning slightly at the phone, a question forming. Top right: close-up of Ji-woo's face lit by the phone, eyes narrowing in doubt, one eyebrow raised. Bottom left: a university computer room at night in 2019: two young researchers at desks with large monitors that show only abstract coloured blocks (no text), cables and a server rack, focused. Bottom right: a huge dark wall filled with hundreds of tiny glowing browser windows, each just a small blank coloured rectangle, receding into the distance, a feeling of vast scale.
sheets.room4: Top left: a present-day Korean government consumer-agency office in daylight: two investigators at desks comparing prices on monitors that show only blank coloured blocks, a wall calendar with empty squares, documents in folders. Top right: a present-day British consumer researcher (a middle-aged man in a cardigan) pinning small blank price-tag cards along a very long year calendar on an office wall, tracking prices over a whole year. Bottom left: Ji-woo sitting up in bed, looking at the glowing phone with a neutral, uncertain expression, unable to tell. Bottom right: Ji-woo with the phone resting on her knees, both palms turned up in a small puzzled shrug, head tilted.
sheets.room5: Ji-woo's bedroom at night. Top left: Ji-woo with a small realization, raising her index finger, eyes brightening, as if giving something a name. Top right: Ji-woo tilting her head with a soft thought bubble above her showing a huge warehouse shelf stacked with the very same dark-navy puffer jacket, a hundred of them. Bottom left: close-up of her right thumb lifting away from the phone's empty glowing screen, her hand relaxing. Bottom right: Ji-woo lying back on the pillow with her eyes closed, calm, thinking, the phone resting on her chest.
sheets.room6: Ji-woo's bedroom at night, the ending. Top left: Ji-woo sitting in bed looking over at the clothes rack by the wall where a perfectly good older winter coat hangs, remembering something. Top right: the phone lying face-up on the cream duvet, its empty screen glowing, Ji-woo's hand resting a little away from it. Bottom left: Ji-woo sitting up calmly with a small, settled smile, looking down at the phone in her lap. Bottom right: a wide quiet view of the bedroom at night, city lights in the window, Ji-woo lying in bed peacefully, the phone's glow faded, the low lamp warm.
sheets.office: Ji-woo does NOT appear in any of these four frames, and none of the people here may look like her (no bob haircut with a hair clip). Top left: a present-day Korean government consumer-agency office in daylight: a middle-aged male investigator with short grey hair and glasses and a young female investigator with a long ponytail, at desks comparing prices on monitors that show only blank coloured blocks, a wall calendar with empty squares, folders. Top right: close-up of the female investigator with the long ponytail drawing a small check mark with a pen on a long blank printed table, a highlighter beside it, serious and focused. Bottom left: a university computer room at night in 2019: two young male researchers (one with short black hair and a grey hoodie, one with curly hair and a navy sweater) at desks with large monitors that show only abstract coloured blocks, a server rack with small lights. Bottom right: close-up of a large monitor showing a grid of many small blank web-page thumbnails being scanned one by one, a soft highlight moving across them, the researcher's silhouette in front.
